I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position at Wolf Oil Corporation. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content management, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your global channels and campaigns.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress websites. Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist position at Wolf Oil Corporation. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content management, I am drawn to the hands-on, full-spectrum nature of this role and the opportunity to work within a global, dynamic team.

In my current role at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to your responsibilities. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring content is accurate and aligned with strategy. I regularly use Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and guide decisions—skills that translate well to maintaining digital dashboards and compiling quarterly reports.

My own project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to manage a complete digital presence: I designed and built the site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD) for enhanced search visibility, and integrated social media. This project also reflects my curiosity and drive to improve efficiency, as I continuously audit and optimize for both traditional and AI-powered search engines.

I am comfortable with CMS platforms and eager to learn Kontent.ai. My experience with social media content and integration, combined with my analytical mindset, positions me to support your social media strategy and collaborate effectively with regional teams and agencies. I am detail-oriented, structured, and proactive in flagging improvements—qualities that align with your need for a self-sufficient operator.

Fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving, I am well-prepared to work in your international environment. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am excited about the prospect of contributing to Wolf Oil Corporation's digital growth.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
